newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FORECAST - Piltel 1996 net seen up despite cloning.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Piltel 1996 net seen up despite cloning.

text.p: Cellular phone firm Pilipino Telephone Corporation is seen posting a 19 percent rise in 1996 net income to 978.76 million pesos despite a major problem over fraudulent calls, a Reuter poll of brokers showed.
In 1995, Piltel, a unit of Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, posted a net income of 822.075 million pesos.

The poll of seven brokerages completed on Tuesday showed that in 1997, Piltel's profits were expected to increase by a further 48 percent to 1.446 billion pesos, mainly on account of an increase in its subscriber base.
Piltel has been troubled by fraudulent calls done by organised groups using sophisticated cloning devices.

"There is still expansion in its cellular subscriber base in 1996 and the only thing that slowed down the company's revenue generation was the fact that they had this cloning problem," said Ricardo Puig, analyst at Peregrine Securities.
Last November, Piltel acknowledged that it was the victim of cloning which would mean a 300 million peso loss for the company for the year 1996.
